args: Nnngh... It seems...this is as far as I go...

I'd hoped to hold out...a bit longer...

but you people are exhausting...

Target neutralized.

If we have no further cause to linger, let's hurry on.
Agreed. We need to get to that ritual hall yesterday.
Then...you aren't going to finish me?

If you kill me here, my Sigil's connection will claim Basileus as well.

If you aim to stop him, this is the easiest way.

Is that a feeble attempt to sway us?

Well, we don't have time for it. Everyone run! NOW!
But I fear you all will come to regret that decision.
By the Goddess... This is a horror.

Such carnage...

Are the 666 already dead, then?
Where is Origa? I know she was here!

Then I invite you to pick through the corpses until you find

who you're looking for. Oh, but you might need some gloves.

My, my! The ever-composed Regina finally loses her cool.

I'm lucky to have seen such a rare sight before the end.

Didn't you feel it the moment you stepped into this place?

The countdown to Satan's glorious rebirth is upon us!

Harle? ...No, you must be the impostor. Wow, you did a really good job with that-

I can barely make out any difference.

So you've met the real Harle? In that case, I suppose it's time.

Can't have you running about just calling me "impostor" all the livelong day, now can we?
From now on, you can just call me Loki.

I don't give a hoot WHAT you want to be called!

I don't see Satan stomping around this place, which means there's still time.

Certainly, depending on the effort,

it's even possible that you might prevent his resurrection from coming about.
More demonic entities? This isn't good.

None of that changes what we must do.

We take them down and stop Satan's revival for good!

Then let's all do our part as hands of the Goddess!

Sigil, release!
Time to pick up where we left off in Rozcimea, Basileus!

Hmph. If you're so eager to finish what we started,

I trust you've come up with a countermeasure for...this?

Things won't be so easy for you this time.

Regina's already analyzed your little toy and blocked its effects.

I should hope this would prove more of

a challenge than last time.

(We seem evenly matched, but they may even have a slight advantage

after our all-out battle with Michael.)

(The longer this drags on, the worse it gets for us.

Better finish it now!)

(Huh?! One of the demonic entities fell! I see.

They mean to turn this from a brawl into a series of small engagements.)

(...Loki seems aware of what they're doing as well. In that case,

I'll follow his lead and stay put. We'll take them as they come.)

(We aim for the moment they strike. When they come for

what they believe is a single target, they'll find two waiting!)

If you fancy keeping your head firmly mounted atop your shoulders,

friend, then I would advise you not to move.

And the real one appears! How exciting.

Have you been acting alone all this while just to create this opportunity?

Glad my impostor at least has my smarts.

Loki, was it? It's been just AGES.

I'm rather flattered to see you still wearing my body all these years later.

Not that I can blame you, of course—I really am something of a handsome devil.

In fact, I'm rather thankful, given present circumstances.

Pity for you, though.

Nice work, Harle!

We'll manage fine so long as you keep Basileus pinned down!

Aw, why so quiet?

Has the sudden turn of events left you speechless?
That's the last of the demonic entities!

Now only you remain, Loki.

Surrender and relinquish the Sacred Shard.
But this Shard contains the mana I need to summon Satan!

If I gave this up,

all my plans to will be foiled and the day will be saved.

The ground's shaking...

And there's miasma!

Bow before might, as all lives must.

There can be no escape.

This little dear possesses power far greater than the demonic entities

you faced before. I trust you'll enjoy your time together!

content.content: When the guests gathered in the ritual hall are slaughtered, the apostles are left to mount a last-ditch fight against Basileus and Loki to stop Satan's resurrection. But just as victory seems to be within reach, Loki summons a new and powerful demonic entity.
